adjudication.rationale: In `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts`, the email send is wrapped in `try/catch`, but the `catch (err)` ignores the error object and only does `console.log("Error sending AddGuestsEmails")`. This both swallows the underlying failure details and uses `console.log` rather than a structured/app logger, making production diagnosis harder; the mutation still returns success even if emails fail.
